scenario: 今天的个性化赛道把目光从单个打分模型移到它周围的系统。长历史被压成可复用的在线表征，整条从检索到重排的级联也可以按用户来编排，而且不必让在线请求去等大模型；排序模型本身，则开始由人在回路上的智能体提出改动、训练并评估。策略试验要把样本用在两种策略真正分叉的动作上，而不是耗在双方都会选的重合处。物品侧信息要在防反演的同时保住相对关系，长尾曝光得先被召回来，再决定要不要调用大模型；连互动强度也可以在动态图上做全候选排序。共同的问题是：个性化一旦离开被验证过的那一处，服务预算、试验设计和隐私约束就会把它改写。

papers.title: X-split Argus: Learning Reusable History Tokens for Efficient CTR Prediction
papers.authors: Alexander Ploshkin, Nikita Stepanov, Alexey Pismenny, Viacheslav Ovchinnikov, Nikolay Savushkin
papers.summary: 工业广告点击率预测既要抓住用户的长期偏好，也要跟上近期意图，但每次给候选打分都把完整行为历史重算一遍，算力和延迟都很难扛。一套广告排序框架把历史压缩器和在线排序器一起训练：离线把过往行为压成一套可复用的历史 token，在线排序只用交叉注意力读取这些 token 和近期事件，候选之间不必重复扫描长历史。离线评估里，相对线上原模型，归一化熵相对下降 0.81%。部署到大规模实时竞价系统后，为期七天的 A/B 试验中，反映广告主转化金额的指标相对提高 4.65%，点击量相对提高 2.96%；服务同等流量大约要多用 15% 的同型号在线 GPU。==把长历史压成可复用的离线表征，排序才能在预算内做厚。==
papers.abstract: Accurate click-through rate (CTR) prediction depends on user representations that capture both persistent preferences and recent intent, yet processing extensive behavioral histories for every ranking request is costly under production compute and latency constraints. We present X-split ARGUS, a framework for ad ranking whose history compressor and online ranker are trained end to end. The compressor encodes past interactions into a compact set of tokens that are computed offline and reused across candidates, while the online ranker scores ads through cross-attention to these tokens and representations of recent events. Training combines an autoregressive loss for click feedback with distillation of candidate-specific click logits from a larger teacher that scores each candidate using the uncompressed history. The number of compressed history tokens and the length of recent history can be adjusted to fit serving compute and latency budgets. Offline evaluation shows a 0.81% relative red
papers.score_note: 工业广告 CTR：离线 NE -0.81%，线上 A/B 转化价值 +4.65%、点击 +2.96%；历史 token 离线压缩+在线 cross-attention。未见开源，实用性记 4 而非 5。

papers.title: MARS Technical Report
papers.authors: Tong Liu, Chaoqun Hou, Longxiang Xiong, Junhong Lou, Jiaqi Zheng, Qixin Li, Zixin Zhao, Yong Duan, Xiannian Hu, Fengze Jiang, Yu Zhu, Cheng Guo, Xinyuan Qi, Zi Zhuang, Ping Liu, Lv Shao, Zongwei Wang
papers.summary: 工业推荐通常是检索、粗排、精排和重排的级联，但通道要不要开、名额怎么分、用哪套模型、分数如何融合，往往仍是工程师按场景统一调好、对所有用户一视同仁的。一套近线智能体把个性化从单阶段打分扩到整条链路的编排：它为每个用户生成一份七维配置，校验后写入缓存，在线级联异步读取，不必等待大模型当场推理。在淘宝五类营销场景、覆盖逾千万日活用户的为期两周 A/B 试验里，各场景关键指标的点估计均为正，其中访客购买率最大相对提高 5.22%，成交总额最大相对提高 7.34%；评测部署的在线服务路径平均延迟还比原系统低 12 毫秒。==级联怎么走，也可以按用户来编，而不必让在线请求去等大模型。==
papers.abstract: Modern industrial recommender systems use multi-stage cascades--retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking--to narrow millions of candidates to a personalized list. While each stage deploys sophisticated models, pipeline-level decisions on channel activation, quotas, model selection, and score fusion remain engineer-tuned and user-agnostic within each scenario. This report presents MARS (Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System), extending personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration. A near-line agent built on fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B generates per-user configurations--a seven-dimensional action covering pipeline mode, retrieval quotas, model selection, fusion weights, and reranker settings--from a constrained action space. Configurations are validated, cached, and consumed asynchronously; the cascade never waits for LLM inference. Schema checks, fallbacks, and a kill switch ensure serving safety. The policy is trained in three stages: Confidence
papers.score_note: MARS：把个性化从单阶段模型扩到检索-粗排-精排-重排的全链路编排（近线 agent）。工业推荐系统论文，证据以技术报告表述为主，证据记 3。

papers.title: MLE Agents: Autonomous ML Engineering in Large-scale Recommendation Systems
papers.authors: Matthew Li, Albert Liang, Dilip Raj
papers.summary: 要改进大规模搜索排序或推荐模型，工程师通常得自己提假设、改代码、训练再评估，周期长，也容易只在熟悉的方向里打转。一套人在回路上的机器学习工程师智能体，可以在工业级搜索排序器上提出改动、写成代码、启动训练并阅读离线评估，再决定是否留下；人仍把住目标设计、搜索方向和最终模型审查。一次战役完成了 1097 次候选实验，接受率为 29.6%，高于目标函数和搜索约束都不同的此前战役的 15.6%。其中最好的模型在大规模 A/B 试验里把搜索量提高了 0.23%，有些架构改动是团队此前从未在这条链路上试过的。==在工业改模里，环路怎么设计，往往和底座模型一样关键。==
papers.abstract: The typical workflow for improving large-scale ranking and recommendation models is slow and tedious: an engineer forms a hypothesis, implements it as a code change, trains a model, and evaluates it both offline and online, often relying on their own intuition and experience along the way. Autonomous LLM agents promise to speed this up by running the loop on their own, but it is still unclear whether they can do this in industry-scale systems rather than on benchmarks or small proxy tasks. We build human-on-the-loop machine learning engineer (MLE) agents that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes on large-scale search rankers. Engineers retain control over objective design, search direction, and final-model review. We identify three obstacles that make this industry setting challenging: feedback takes hours per experiment, offline metrics do not always predict online impact, and improvements saturate after the early wins. We address these with parallel training runs, an
papers.score_note: MLE Agents：在工业级搜索排序/推荐模型上做人机协同的假设-改代码-训练-评估闭环。任务是改排序模型而非通用 agent。摘要未报完整线上指标，证据记 3。

papers.title: Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing
papers.summary: 上线新的推荐或排序策略前通常要做 A/B 试验，一旦新策略和线上策略经常选出同一动作，这些重合样本对估计效果差异帮助很小，却会把方差抬高，试验就得耗掉大量流量。现有降方差方法多半是在收集方案定死后再改估计器，或只优化两组之间的流量切分，无法把样本送到两种策略意见不一致的动作上。这里把动作如何抽样、观测如何用来估计处理效应放在一起优化，并利用历史日志为估计配置对照变量。在模拟的策略 A/B 中，基于模型对照的设计只需平衡试验 39% 到 51% 的评估流量，就能达到相同均方误差。在一万次评估互动时，统计功效还能提高到平衡试验的 1.5 到 2.1 倍。==策略试验要把样本用在两种策略真正分叉的地方。==
papers.abstract: Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree. In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to e
papers.score_note: 针对推荐/排序策略 A/B 的方差最优反事实设计，直接降低线上实验样本量。方法清楚，摘要未给完整数据集清单，证据记 3。

papers.title: PGPO: Prototype-Guided Progressive Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
papers.authors: Shengxiang Lin, Jiajie Su, Pengyang Zhou, Xiang Chen, Xiaolin Zheng, Feng Tian, Chaochao Chen
papers.summary: 大模型增强的推荐会把物品的文本侧信息编进语义向量，却可能被反演攻击还原出敏感属性。现有输入侧防护要么依赖可信采集，要么在本地扰动 token，常常把物品之间的相对关系也搅乱了，推荐效用跟着掉。这里把目标改成关系保真：语义要偏移到难以还原，但物品之间的相对关系还得留下来。方法先为高影响的原型词学习感知拓扑的混淆锚点，再沿静态语义图传播，并用差异、结构一致和语义约束来优化。在两个基准上，各类混淆方法都能把反演攻击成功率相对原始描述降低一半以上；对传统协同过滤模型，相对原文上限，推荐指标下降通常不到 2%，下游效果也好于只扰动 token 的做法。==保隐私不一定非得以拆掉物品关系为代价。==
papers.abstract: LLM-enhanced recommender systems encode item side information into semantic embeddings, but these embeddings may leak sensitive textual attributes through inversion attacks. Existing input-side defenses rely on trusted collection or local token perturbation, often disrupting the inter-item semantic topology needed for recommendation. To address it, we introduce relational fidelity as the key objective, requiring semantic shift for privacy while preserving relative item relations for utility. Based on this principle, we propose prototype-guided progressive obfuscation (PGPO), which learns topology-aware obfuscation anchors for high-influence prototype words and propagates them through a static semantic graph. PGPO is optimized with GRPO using individual dissimilarity, structural consistency, and semantic constraint rewards. Experiments on two benchmarks show strong inversion defense with near-upper-bound recommendation performance. The code is available at https://github.com/Shengxiang-
papers.score_note: PGPO：保护 LLM-enhanced 推荐中的语义 embedding 不被反演，同时保持 item 关系。有代码链接与两套基准，属判别式/增强式推荐而非生成 item token，留在本赛道。

papers.title: AgentTailor: Dual-Gate LLM-Assisted Re-ranking for Personalized Long-Tail Recommendation
papers.authors: Jinpeng Chen, Zhenye Yang, Huan Li, Kaimin Wei, Senzhang Wang, Hongbo Gao
papers.summary: 推荐系统很容易出现头部物品占满曝光、大量长尾物品几乎没机会被看见的情况。现有长尾方法常常靠全局重新加权，或把排序过程做成不透明的模型，既难按个人去提高长尾曝光，又容易伤到整体推荐效果。一套模块化的大模型辅助框架把这件事拆成两段：先用语义召回取出语义上相近的候选池，让相关的长尾物品有机会进入后续排序；再由一条按需启用的长尾专支路，依据证据做重排。这条支路用双门控来调节长尾压力：激活门决定要不要调用大模型去做基于证据的评估，放置门再决定提炼出的证据是否允许进入最终排序。==长尾曝光要先保证被召回来，再决定要不要为此调用大模型。==
papers.abstract: Recommender systems are central to modern digital platforms but remain vulnerable to popularity bias, where head items dominate exposure while many long-tail items are underrepresented. Existing long-tail methods often rely on global reweighting or opaque ranking models, making it difficult to personalize tail exposure without degrading recommendation utility. To address this challenge, we propose AgentTailor, a modular LLM-assisted framework for personalized long-tail recommendation. AgentTailor decomposes recommendation into two complementary stages. First, a semantic recall module retrieves a semantically aligned candidate pool, determining whether relevant long-tail items are accessible to later ranking. Second, a conditional tail-specialist branch performs evidence-based re-ranking through a dual-gate tail-pressure router: the activation gate decides whether LLM-assisted evidence assessment should be invoked, while the placement gate decides whether the extracted evidence is allow
papers.score_note: AgentTailor：语义召回 + 双门控 LLM 辅助重排，针对个性化长尾曝光。会议论文，时效用 discovered_at（近 7 天）记 4。生成式赛道回送的迟到 handoff，已并入本赛道候选。

papers.title: DyNA-Mixer: Decoupling Time and Topology for Scalable Dynamic Node Affinity Prediction
papers.authors: Yuanxing Zheng, Liping Wang, Xuemin Lin
papers.summary: 连续时间动态图保留了互动的先后、时刻和强度，对推荐和交易网络重要，但研究长期停在只预测未来会不会连上，许多应用还要预报互动有多强，并在全部候选上排序。动态节点亲和预测把任务扩成连续目标和全候选排序，既要刻画多尺度时间演变和全图协同，又不能对每个节点对都做昂贵预报。一套方法把时间预报和协同结构建模拆开，用多尺度时间预报刻画成对亲和变化，再用虚拟协同图在查询时刻聚合相关互动，并只对近期仍有非零亲和的节点对做昂贵计算。在四个时序图基准上，NDCG@10 都达到当时最好，最大基准相对最强基线，测试集相对提高 17.8%。==强度预测可以做全候选排序，也不必对所有节点对付同样的计算。==
papers.abstract: Continuous-time dynamic graphs preserve the ordering, timing, and evolving strength of interactions that static snapshots discard, making dynamic graph mining essential for evolving systems such as recommender systems, trade networks, and transaction platforms. Research in this area has centered on dynamic link prediction, which forecasts only whether a future interaction will occur, whereas many applications also need its intensity. The dynamic node affinity prediction (DNAP) problem generalizes this task to continuous targets and full-candidate ranking, making it more broadly applicable but substantially harder. This raises two coupled difficulties: ranking requires a predictor expressive enough to capture both multi-scale temporal evolution and graph-wide collaborative patterns, yet running such a predictor over every source--destination pair is computationally prohibitive. We propose DyNA-Mixer, which decouples temporal forecasting from collaborative structure modeling. It adopts a
papers.score_note: 动态图节点亲和预测，摘要将推荐作为应用之一，核心是通用 DNAP，记 adjacent。
